title: Foodlink F&B Holdings (India) IPO
summary: Foodlink F&B Holdings (India) IPO is a ₹360.76 crore book-built issue priced at ₹180–₹191 per share, to be listed on BSE and NSE. It is open from November 26 to November 30, 2026, with allotment expected on December 1 and listing on December 3, 2026. The minimum investment is ₹14,898 for 78 shares.

Incorporated in the year 2003, Foodlink F&B Holdings (India) Ltd. is a food and beverages services company providing premium catering services and operating casual dining restaurants and cloud kitchens. Located in Mumbai, Foodlink offers services for weddings, social occasions, corporate events and other large events. Restaurant offerings of the company include China Bistro, India Bistro, Glocal and Art of Dum. The company also works through its international subsidiary located in UAE, strengthening its footprint in the international food and hospitality industry. · · Business Model: · Events Catering, · Casual Dining Restaurants & Cloud Kitchens, · Banquets and Integrated F&B Services (Jade Luxury Banquets). · · Till date, i.e., till 30th September 2026, we operate in India, United Arab Emirates, United Kingdom and Malaysia, and have provided services for events in countries such as Switzerland, Turkey, Italy, Spain, United Arab Emirates, France, Oman, Qatar, Egypt, Jordan, Maldives, Thailand, Nigeria, United Kingdom and Malaysia. · · The company runs 28 Casual Dining Restaurants & Cloud Kitchens. They are situated in India and United Arab Emirates, where there are 15 Casual Dining Restaurants & Cloud Kitchens in two cities in India at ten different locations and 13 Casual Dining Restaurants & Cloud Kitchens in United Arab Emirates in two cities at seven different locations. There are five centralized kitchens owned by the company in India, located in Mumbai (Maharashtra), Ahmedabad (Gujarat), Mohali (Punjab), Hyderabad (Telangana), and New Delhi. · As of September 30, 2026, the company had 1,481 employees.
Sanjay Manohar Vazirani are the company's promoters of Foodlink F&B Holdings (India).

b.p: Foodlink F&B Holdings (India) Limited has allocated 84,99,483 equity shares to anchor investors at ₹191 per share, raising ₹162.34 crore ahead of its IPO. · · The allocation was made to 12 institutional investors, including Amicorp Capital (Mauritius) Limited, Founders Collective Fund, SG Finserve Limited, ITI Mutual Fund, Nippon India Equity Opportunities AIF – Scheme 9, Svan Velocity Fund and Meru Investment Fund. · · One domestic mutual fund, ITI Mutual Fund, received 14,39,802 shares (16.94% of the anchor portion) across two schemes.

sections.h: Foodlink F&B Holdings (India) IPO - Strengths and Risks

b.p: Foodlink F&B Holdings (India) IPO strengths and risks highlight key business factors, financial position, and market sentiment that may impact investor interest.

Largest Player in Luxury Catering Services: As per the F&S Report, it was India's largest player in terms of revenue in FY 2025 among its competitors offering organized services in ultra-luxury and luxury catering including wedding services, MICE events, sports, personal celebrations, and banquets catered to an exclusive and expanding segment of premium customers.

Innovative Food Solutions for Select Customers: It offers innovative and high-quality food solutions to film actors, cricketers, HNIs, large corporations, and government entities with a recurring business demonstrated through 214, 309, and 180 repeat customers in FYs 2026, 2025, and 2024 respectively.

Strategically Positioned Kitchens: It maintains seven centrally positioned kitchens covering an area of 91,500 sq ft with a capability of producing more than 100,000 meals daily allowing a hub and spoke model with a light asset base.

Undisclosed Locations for Proposed Facilities: The company has failed to identify the locations for the Proposed Centralized Kitchen, Proposed Banquets and Proposed Casual Dining Restaurants from Net Proceeds, and any delay in identifying suitable locations and obtaining approvals may have an adverse impact on the commencement of operations and future growth.

Capital Expenditure Orders Not Yet Placed: Capital expenditure orders for the Proposed Centralized Kitchen, Proposed Banquets and Proposed Casual Dining Restaurants have not yet been placed by the company, and any delay or failure of the vendors might impact the company's operations and results of operations.

Past History of Losses at the Company and Subsidiaries: The company has experienced losses for the fiscal year 2024 amounting to ₹184.61 million. Also, certain subsidiaries, such as Foodlink Global Restaurant & Catering Services LLC, have witnessed losses on account of geopolitical instability and new business openings.
